name: mashhor-prototype
description: Mashhor Vehicle Inspection and Approval System — client-demo prototype (admin site + portal) on the existing Backend /api/mashoor module.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix admin && npm install --prefix portal
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix admin && npm run build --prefix portal
scripts.preview: concurrently -k -n api,admin,portal -c blue,magenta,green "npm:dev:api" "npm run preview --prefix admin" "npm run preview --prefix portal"
